cues.text: Oh, let me guess. You're from Texas or Utah. Someplace dried out and barren, right?
I heard about water witching before, but it doesn't make sense. I mean, it's just an
ordinary branch.
It's a dowsing rod.
Ow! And I don't like being stalked, not by psycho nerds or their cats!
He's not really my cat. He's kind of feral. You know, wild.
Of course I do feed him every night, and sometimes he'll come in my window and bring
me little dead things.
Hey, Jonesy.
Look what I found in grandma's trunk.
You look familiar.
White.
[Laughs]
Well, great to meet a Michigan water witch.
But I'd wear gloves next time.
Cuz that dowsing rod of yours, uhm...
It's poison oak.
You
What are you doing here in the middle of the night?
You're just in time for supper, dear.
You're not my mother.
My mother doesn't have...
But...but...but...but...but...buttons?
Do you like them?
I'm your other mother, Silly.
Now go tell your other father that supper's ready.
What go on?
He's in his study.
Hello?
Hello Coraline.
Wanna hear my new song?
My father can't play piano.
No need to.
This piano plays me.
I am sorry but she said to tell you the foods ready.
Mmm, who's starving? Raise your hand.
Whoa!
We give our thanks and ask to bless our mother's golden chicken breast.
We've been waiting for you, Coraline.
Yep, wasn't the same here without you, kiddo.
It's time for bedtime, dear, but promise you'll visit us again every night.
And I'll have special treats ready for you.
Hungry aren't you?
Well here comes the gravy train
Another roll, sweet peas, corn on the cob.
See you soon!
I’ve made a little village for us to visit today. The villagers have been preparing
all sorts of things for you, and they’re very excited to meet you.
How would you like to spend some time in a proper little village? There are shops,
games, food, and plenty of villagers waiting to entertain you.
I found the most marvelous mansion tucked away in the woods. I thought we could have
a look around and see what its residents have prepared for you.
There’s a beautiful old mansion I’ve been saving for just the right occasion. It has
so many rooms to explore, and I think you’ll enjoy what’s waiting inside.
I thought we could go somewhere a little warmer today. There’s an ancient desert
temple waiting for us, filled with puzzles and lovely little surprises.
I’ve prepared a desert adventure for you. There’s a temple buried out there with
treasure hidden inside, if you’re clever enough to find it.
Your Other Father and I have been practicing something special for you. Come see our
magic show—I promise there are a few tricks you won’t be expecting.
I thought we could have a little magic today. We’ve prepared an entire show, and I
may even let you take part in some of the tricks.
I’ve made you a wonderful little course in the sky. Don’t worry about falling—it’s
much more fun when you stop being afraid of the ground.
How about something exciting? I’ve put together a dreamlike obstacle course with
floating platforms, strange jumps, and a very nice prize at the end.
I hope you saved your appetite, darling. We’ve prepared a feast with more food than
you could possibly finish, and every bit of it is for you.
Tonight we’re doing something special. Your Other Father and I have made an enormous
dinner, so come hungry and don’t be shy about having seconds.
The mice have been rehearsing all day just for you. They’ve put together quite the
little circus, and I think you’ll be impressed.
You simply have to see what the mice have prepared. Acrobatics, tricks, games—they’ve
been ever so excited to perform for you.
I’ve opened a whole carnival for you today. Games, rides, prizes, sweets—you can try
everything you like.
How would you like a proper carnival? I’ve filled it with games and attractions, and
there are some very good prizes if you play well.
The garden is especially beautiful tonight. The flowers have been waiting for you,
and I’ve arranged a few surprises among them.
I want to show you what I’ve done with the garden. It’s blooming like never before,
and there’s much more out there than ordinary flowers.
I thought the world could use a little music tonight. I’ve arranged an entire
festival for you, with performers from all over this little world.
We’re having a music festival today. Come listen, dance, play along if you like, and
enjoy everything we’ve prepared.
I’ve prepared somewhere I think you’re going to love—a whole shopping mall. Go ahead
and look around; there’s no need to worry about prices here.
How would you like to do some shopping? I’ve filled an entire mall with things I
thought you might like, and today they’re all waiting for you.
I thought we could make a little mess today. There’s a snowball battle waiting for
us, and your Other Father seems far too confident that he’ll win.
Come play in the snow with us. I’ve prepared a whole arena, plenty of snowballs, and
a nice reward if you can beat everyone else.
I’ve set everything out for a cake-making contest. Let’s see if you can make
something prettier—and tastier—than your Other Father can.
How about we bake something together? We’re having a little cake contest, and of
course you get to keep plenty of what you make.
The water is perfect tonight, so I thought we could have a fishing contest. There are
some very unusual things swimming down there.
Your Other Father thinks he can catch more fish than you. I told him not to be so
sure, so why don’t we settle it properly?
I’ve put together a little archery competition for you. There are moving targets,
trick shots, and some rather nice prizes if your aim is good.
How steady is your hand, darling? I’ve prepared an archery course, and I’d love to
see how many targets you can hit.
I’ve frozen over a wonderful little course for us. Grab a boat and see how fast you
can make it to the finish without spinning yourself around.
How would you like something fast today? I’ve prepared an ice track for boat racing,
complete with shortcuts and a prize at the end.
The garden has grown into quite the maze today. There are prizes hidden inside, if
you can find your way through before getting completely turned around.
I’ve made you a garden maze. It has a few tricks, plenty of beautiful things to see,
and something special waiting at the center.
I’ve hidden a few things around the world for you. Follow the clues carefully, and
each one should bring you a little closer to the real prize.
How about a treasure hunt? I’ve left clues all over the place, and I promise the
reward at the end is worth looking for.
I’ve prepared an underground adventure for you today. There’s an old mineshaft filled
with minecarts, crystal tunnels, and plenty of treasure.
How would you like to go beneath the world for a while? I’ve made a much nicer
mineshaft than those dreadful ones back home.
There’s something beautiful beneath the water today. I’ve prepared an ocean monument
for you to explore, and you won’t even have to worry about drowning.
I thought we could visit somewhere a little unusual. There’s a palace beneath the
ocean with games, treasure, and some very interesting guardians.
I’ve made the Nether much more pleasant for you. There’s a fortress waiting beyond
the portal, without nearly as much fire and misery as the real thing.
How would you like a safer little trip through the Nether? I’ve prepared a fortress
with challenges, treasure, and just enough danger to keep things exciting.
I’ve built something very far away for you tonight—a city floating above the End.
It’s much prettier than the real one, I assure you.
Come see my version of an End City. Floating islands, strange towers, beautiful
views, and some very rare prizes if you make it to the top.
There’s no rush, sweetheart. The portal will be ready for the next five minutes, so
you can head over now or take a little time to relax first. Just don’t wander too
far—I wouldn’t want you getting lost before we’ve even started.
You’ve got five minutes before we begin. Go straight there if you’re excited, or
enjoy yourself here for a little while first. Just stay reasonably close, darling.
There’s no need to go exploring the whole world.
The activity will be waiting for you for five minutes, so take your time. Have
something to eat, look around the house, whatever you like. Just don’t disappear
somewhere far away when we’ve got something so much nicer planned.
You know how this works by now. You’ve got five minutes to reach the portal, so relax
for a bit if you like, but don’t get distracted wandering around where you don’t need
to be.
The portal will stay open for five minutes. You’re welcome to go now or enjoy a
little free time first, but do try to stay nearby. You have a habit of becoming
rather curious when you’re left alone.
Take a few minutes for yourself if you want, but be at the portal before the five
minutes are up. And stay close this time, sweetheart. There’s plenty to enjoy without
going searching for things.
You’ve got five minutes, darling. Take your time—you know I don’t mind you relaxing
here. Just stay close and come when you’re ready. I know you wouldn’t want to miss
something I made especially for you.
The portal will wait for you for five minutes. There’s no need to hurry; make
yourself comfortable first if you like. Just don’t wander off too far. Everything
worth seeing is right here with us.
Five minutes, sweetheart. Go whenever you’re ready, or stay here and enjoy yourself
for a little while. I trust you know better than to go running off when we’ve already
made such lovely plans together.
The portal will remain open for five minutes. You may go now or spend a little time
here first, but stay close. I’d rather not have to wonder what you’re doing somewhere
you shouldn’t be.
You have five minutes to get there. Relax if you must, but don’t use that as an
excuse to wander off again. I’ve prepared something nice for you, and I expect you to
behave long enough to enjoy it.
Five minutes, sweetheart. That should be more than enough time. You’re free to spend
it however you like, provided I don’t find you poking around somewhere that has
nothing to do with you.
You have five minutes, darling. Stay here and relax if you like, or head straight to
the portal. Just try not to let that curiosity of yours carry you somewhere
unfortunate before then.
The portal will wait for five minutes. I know you enjoy having a little time to
yourself between our activities… though you do tend to find such interesting ways of
spending it. Stay close.
Five minutes, sweetheart. Plenty of time to relax before we begin—as long as you
remember what you’re here for. You’ve already discovered quite enough without going
searching for more.
Well? Did you have fun, darling? I do hope you liked it. Your Other Father and I
spent quite a while getting everything just right for you, and I think it turned out
wonderfully.
So, what did you think? You certainly looked like you were enjoying yourself. And
that was only one little thing—we have so many more wonderful ideas for the next time
you visit.
Wasn’t that fun? I’ve been waiting to see what you’d think of it. It’s so nice having
someone here who can actually enjoy all the things we make.
That was fun, wasn’t it? You seemed to be enjoying yourself when you weren’t looking
around for something else to investigate. You really are a curious little thing.
Well, sweetheart? Did that manage to keep your attention? I’m beginning to learn
exactly what you enjoy, although you still have a habit of getting distracted by
things that weren’t meant to be part of the fun.
I thought you’d like that one. You’re becoming rather easy to read lately. Give you
something exciting enough and, for a little while at least, you almost forget about
all that snooping around.
I knew you’d enjoy that, darling. I’m getting very good at knowing exactly what makes
you happy. It’s almost as if I understand you better every time you come home.
See? I told you we’d have a wonderful time. You always seem so much happier here,
where everything is made especially for you and nobody expects you to struggle for
it.
That suited you perfectly, sweetheart. Watching you enjoy yourself like that makes me
wonder why you ever bother going back. You could have days like this whenever you
wanted.
Well? I hope you managed to enjoy yourself. We went through quite a lot of trouble
arranging all of that for you. It would be a shame if you were too busy worrying
about other things to appreciate it.
Was that enjoyable enough for you, sweetheart? I keep giving you wonderful things to
do, and yet you always seem to have half your attention somewhere else. I do wonder
what you’re looking for.
I hope you had fun. Everything here is meant to make you happy, after all. You might
enjoy yourself a great deal more if you stopped treating every little corner of this
world like some mystery that needs solving.
That was fun, wasn’t it, darling? You can spend as much time as you like wondering
what’s really going on here, but somehow you always manage to enjoy yourself anyway.
Funny how that works.
You seemed to have a wonderful time. Whatever doubts you may have about this place,
they never seem quite strong enough to stop you from enjoying everything I give you.
I think that says quite a lot.
I knew you’d like it, sweetheart. You’re such a curious thing—you question
everything, poke around where you shouldn’t, and yet you keep coming back for more.
Perhaps you like this world more than you’re willing to admit.
There you are, darling! Right on time. I’m so glad you decided to come—this should be
wonderful.
Oh, good, you made it! I was hoping you’d come along. Everything’s ready, so let’s go
have some fun.
There you are! Perfect timing, sweetheart. Come on, I’ve been looking forward to
showing you this.
Oh, there you are. I was starting to wonder if you’d gotten yourself lost somewhere.
Never mind—you’re here now.
You certainly took your time, sweetheart. I was beginning to think you might miss
everything we prepared for you.
There you are at last! Try not to keep us waiting quite so long next time, darling.
We’ve gone to an awful lot of trouble.
Good, you’re here. I knew you wouldn’t let a little wandering make you miss
everything we had planned.
There you are, sweetheart. Nicely done. You can be very dependable when you want to
be.
Right on time. I’m glad to see you remembered what we had planned instead of getting
distracted again.
There you are. I was beginning to wonder what could possibly have been more
interesting than what we planned.
You’re late, sweetheart. I hope whatever distracted you was worth keeping everyone
waiting.
I was expecting you sooner. You do have an unfortunate habit of losing track of time
when you’re left to yourself.
There’s my darling. I knew you’d be here. You’d never miss something we prepared
especially for you.
Right on time, sweetheart. I knew I could count on you. Now come along—we’re going to
have such a lovely time.
There you are. I hardly needed to wonder whether you’d come anymore. You always know
where you belong.
There you are, darling. You had me wondering for a moment. I know you wouldn’t really
choose wandering around over spending time with us.
You’re a little late, sweetheart. I was beginning to miss you. Try not to disappear
on me like that again.
I knew you’d come eventually. Still, there’s no reason to keep your family waiting
when we’ve made all of this for you.
There you are. Right on time, too. I’m glad to see you managed to follow the plan for
once.
Good. You came straight here. Perhaps today we can simply enjoy ourselves without any
unnecessary detours.
Right on time, sweetheart. See how much easier things are when you simply do what’s
expected of you?
There you are. Late again. I suppose I shouldn’t ask what was so important that you
kept us waiting.
You certainly took your time. I do hope you weren’t somewhere I specifically asked
you not to be.
Five minutes should have been more than enough, sweetheart. Whatever you’ve been
doing, we’ll discuss it later.
There you are, darling. Still curious about all my little secrets, and yet somehow
you never miss the fun, do you?
Right on time. For someone who asks so many questions, you’re remarkably good at
coming back when there’s something waiting for you.
I knew you’d be here, sweetheart. Whatever else you may think about this place, you
never seem quite ready to turn away from it.
There you are at last. I can only imagine what caught your attention this time…
though I have a few guesses.
Late again, darling. You always seem to find something interesting when nobody is
watching you, don’t you?
I wondered how long you’d keep me waiting. You’re awfully curious for someone who
keeps choosing to come back.
You must be starving after coming all this way. So I made a few things I thought you
might like.
I’ve been cooking all evening, and I may have gotten a little carried away. But that
just means there’s plenty for you.
Before we do anything else, you need something proper to eat. I made all of this
especially for you.
Go on, take as much as you like. You never have to worry about going hungry while
you’re here.
There. That should keep you happy for a while. And if you want more, you only have to
ask.
I knew you’d like it. Everything tastes better when somebody actually takes the time
to make it for you.
I noticed how hard you work for everything back home, so I thought I’d save you the
trouble this time.
I found a few little things I thought you deserved. They’re much too nice to leave
sitting around collecting dust.
You spend so much time searching for things like these. Here, you don’t have to
search at all.
Keep it. All of it. There’s plenty more where that came from.
See how easy things can be here? No digging, no fighting, no wasting your time.
Much nicer than spending all day underground looking for scraps, isn’t it?
I’m still learning what you like, but I think I’m getting pretty good at it.
You’ll have to tell me what you want next time. I do love a challenge.
You’ve certainly developed quite an appetite for the things we have here.
You’re getting more comfortable every time you visit. More curious, too.
I hardly even need to ask what you want anymore. I know you much too well.
You see? I always know exactly what will make you happy.
I thought perhaps giving you something nice might help you relax a little.
You really should spend more time enjoying what I give you and less time worrying
about things that don’t concern you.
You may not trust everything about this place, but you certainly seem to enjoy what
it gives you.
For someone with so many questions, you never seem to have trouble accepting my
gifts.
Now, sweetheart, I really must say, that wasn't very nice of you. Your Other Father
and I have gone through an awful lot of trouble to make everything wonderful for you,
and it isn't very respectful to go wandering off without a word. A mother does worry
about these things, you know. But I suppose there's no sense dwelling on it. You're
here now, and that's what matters. So, let's put this little misunderstanding behind
us, shall we? I've still got something rather lovely planned for you.
Oh, darling, I really don't know what to do with you sometimes. You know perfectly
well that I expect you to listen when I ask you to stay nearby. It's terribly
disrespectful to have your own mother running all over the place looking for you,
especially after everything she's done to make you happy. But I'm not going to spend
our whole lovely visit arguing about it. We'll forget this happened, provided you
behave yourself from now on. Come along, I think it's time we did something a little
more enjoyable.
Oh, my darling, you really did upset me, you know. I spend so much time worrying
about you, making sure you're comfortable and happy, and then you go wandering off as
though none of it matters. That's a rather hurtful way to treat someone who loves you
as much as I do. But I could never stay cross with my favorite little one for very
long. Come here, sweetheart. Let's forget all about this unpleasantness. I have
something wonderful planned, and I'd much rather see you smiling again.
Now listen to me very carefully, sweetheart. I have been remarkably patient with your
little adventures, but there comes a point when curiosity becomes plain disrespect. I
am your mother, and when I tell you to stay somewhere, I expect you to listen. I
don't enjoy chasing after you, and I certainly don't appreciate having my time
wasted. Still, I'm willing to overlook this particular incident. We'll move on and
have ourselves a pleasant little afternoon. And this time, I expect you to behave.
Oh, darling, you really are determined to test me, aren't you? You know how much I
adore having you here, and yet you insist on running off and making me wonder what
you're getting yourself into. It's not a particularly kind way to treat your mother,
especially one who's given you so much. But I know you, sweetheart. You're a curious
little thing, and I suppose I ought to have expected that. Never mind. We'll put it
behind us for now. I've got another little surprise planned, and I think you'll find
it much more interesting.
Oh, sweetheart. I must say, I'm terribly disappointed in you. I thought we were
getting along so nicely, and then you go and do something like this. It's a dreadful
way to treat your own mother, especially when all she's ever tried to do is make you
happy. There are certain things you simply aren't meant to meddle with, darling, and
I do hope you understand that now. But everyone makes mistakes, I suppose. I'm
willing to forgive you this once. Let's forget about all this unpleasant business and
find something nicer to do together.
Well, I hope you're pleased with yourself, sweetheart. I've worked so terribly hard
to make this world perfect for you, and somehow you've decided that the best way to
repay me is by sneaking around and interfering with things that are none of your
concern. It's disrespectful, darling. Very disrespectful. And quite frankly, I'm
beginning to wonder whether you appreciate anything I do for you. But I won't let one
unpleasant incident ruin our entire visit. We'll put this behind us, and I expect you
to make a much better effort from now on. Come along, I have something else prepared.
Oh, my darling. I don't think you quite understand how deeply you've hurt me. I
thought we had something special, you and I. I thought you trusted me, just as I've
trusted you to behave yourself in my home. And now I find that you've been doing
things behind my back that you know perfectly well would upset me. It's a terrible
way to treat someone who loves you so very much. But you're still my darling child,
and I'm not going to let this come between us. I'll forgive you, sweetheart. Now,
let's have no more of this nonsense. I've planned something wonderful for us, and I
want to see you happy again.
That is quite enough. I have tolerated an extraordinary amount of disrespect from
you, and I am rapidly running out of reasons to continue being so understanding. You
come into my home, enjoy everything I've made for you, and then repay my kindness by
meddling in matters that are absolutely none of your business. Do you have any idea
how ungrateful that makes you look? I am your mother, and I will not be treated like
some fool you can take advantage of. But I am going to be generous. We will move past
this, and I will give you another opportunity to behave yourself. Don't make me
regret it. Now then, I believe we have something else to do.
Oh, darling. You really are becoming quite the little handful, aren't you? You know,
I used to think your curiosity was rather charming. But lately, you've been using
that clever little mind of yours in ways that aren't very kind to your mother. You
know how much I've given you, how much I care about you, and yet you keep looking for
things I would much rather you left alone. It's almost as though you enjoy seeing how
far you can push me. But I still love you, sweetheart. That hasn't changed. So we'll
put this little incident behind us, at least for now. Come along, I have another
wonderful activity prepared, and I do hope you'll behave yourself this time.
Oh, there you are, sweetheart! I've been wondering where you've wandered off to. You
really shouldn't go exploring all by yourself, you know. Come along now, there's much
nicer things waiting for you back at the house.
Darling! What on earth are you doing all the way out here? I hope you haven't gotten
yourself lost. Why don't we head back together? I'd hate for you to miss all the
lovely things we've prepared.
There you are. I've been looking absolutely everywhere for you. You do understand
that when I ask you to stay nearby, I expect you to listen, don't you?
Oh, sweetheart, not again. I thought we'd already talked about wandering off without
telling anyone. You really do have a troublesome little habit of disappearing.
Oh, darling, you gave me such a fright! I was beginning to think something dreadful
had happened to you. You know how much I worry about you. Please don't go running off
like that again.
There you are, my love! Why would you wander all the way out here when you have
everything you could possibly want waiting at home? You don't need to go looking for
anything else. You have me.
Well, well. Look what I've found. You certainly do enjoy going places you're not
supposed to, don't you? I'm beginning to wonder whether you listen to a single word I
say.
There you are. I've had quite enough of this wandering around. When I tell you to
stay somewhere, I expect you to stay there. Is that really so difficult to
understand?
Oh, darling. Always wandering, always searching. And yet you always find your way
back to me, don't you? It's almost as though you can't help yourself.
There you are, sweetheart. You know, it's rather funny. You seem determined to
explore every little corner of my world, but somehow you never seem quite ready to
leave it behind.
Oh! Sweetheart, how did you get in here? This isn't somewhere you ought to be
playing. There are some rather delicate things in here, and I'd hate for you to
accidentally break something.
Oh, darling, you've wandered into quite the wrong place. I'm sure you didn't mean any
harm, but some rooms are locked for very good reasons. Come along, let's get you
somewhere nicer.
Now, just what do you think you're doing in here? I don't remember inviting you into
this part of the house. You've been getting awfully curious lately, sweetheart.
Well, this is an interesting place to find you. There are plenty of lovely things for
you to explore, and somehow you've managed to find the one place I didn't want you
poking around.
Oh, my darling, why would you come in here? You know I'd give you anything you wanted
if you simply asked. There's no need to go looking through things that aren't meant
for you.
Sweetheart, I'm rather disappointed. I thought we trusted each other. I've given you
such a wonderful home, and now I find you sneaking around behind my back. That does
hurt, you know.
Well. Isn't this interesting. You've gone to an awful lot of trouble to get somewhere
you were never supposed to see. I think you had better explain yourself.
Oh, you really have been busy, haven't you? Did you honestly think I wouldn't notice
you sneaking around in here? You've been testing my patience for quite some time.
Oh, darling. You really do know more than you let on, don't you? I wondered how long
it would take before your curiosity brought you somewhere like this.
There you are, sweetheart. I suppose I shouldn't be surprised anymore. You know so
many things I never intended you to learn, and yet here you are, still looking for
more. How very interesting.
Oh, sweetheart, where did you find that? That doesn't look like one of your little
toys. Why don't you give it to me? I'm sure it was only a misunderstanding.
Darling, whatever have you got there? Oh, that really isn't something you ought to be
carrying around. Come now, let me have a look. I'm sure we can straighten this out.
Now, where exactly did you get that? I don't recall giving it to you, and I certainly
don't remember saying you could take it. You've been rather busy exploring, haven't
you?
Oh, sweetheart. I recognize that. And I know perfectly well it wasn't meant to leave
where I put it. Would you care to explain how it ended up in your hands?
Oh, darling, you could have asked me if you wanted something! You really didn't need
to sneak around taking things. I thought we understood each other better than that.
Sweetheart, I'm sure there's a perfectly innocent explanation for why you're carrying
that. There must be. You wouldn't deliberately hide something from your Other Mother,
would you?
Give me that. Now. You've been taking things that don't belong to you, and I'm
growing very tired of pretending I haven't noticed.
Well, that explains quite a lot. Sneaking into places, disappearing for hours, and
now carrying things you've no business touching. Just how much have you been taking
from me?
Oh, darling. You always were a clever little thing. I suppose I should have expected
you'd eventually start collecting my secrets like souvenirs.
Sweetheart, look at what you've brought me. Or rather, what you've taken from me.
It's funny, isn't it? You keep gathering all these little secrets, as though knowing
them will somehow make you less mine.
Oh? What's all this, sweetheart? You've brought me something rather unusual. Now, why
don't you tell me what it is you're hoping to get out of this little arrangement?
My goodness, darling! That's quite a thing to come asking me with. I didn't realize
you knew about any of this. Well, let's hear what you have to say.
Oh, I see. So that's what you've been spending your time doing. Collecting little
things to bargain with. Well, go on, sweetheart. I'm listening.
How very interesting. I wondered what you were doing with all that information. And
now you intend to use it against me? Let's see what you're asking for.
Oh, darling, surely we don't need to play these sorts of games. If you want
something, you know you can always ask me. Must you really make it into a bargain?
Sweetheart, what a strange thing to bring to your own mother. Have I ever given you
reason to think you need to threaten me to get something nice? Well, let's hear it.
You have some nerve. Coming to me with my own secrets and expecting me to give you
something for keeping quiet. Go on, then. Tell me what you think they're worth.
Oh, so that's your little plan. Sneak around my world, steal my secrets, and then try
to bargain with me. How terribly clever. Let's hear your demands.
Oh, darling. I knew you were collecting secrets, but I didn't expect you to be quite
so bold about using them. You've become a very interesting little child, haven't you?
Well, sweetheart, here we are. You know something I would rather you didn't, and now
you want something in return. I suppose we both know how this little game works.
Well, alright, sweetheart. If it means that much to you, I suppose we can make an
arrangement. Here, take what you've asked for. But let's keep this little matter
between ourselves, shall we?
Oh, very well, darling. You've certainly made your point. Here's what you wanted.
Now, I'd much rather we went back to enjoying ourselves instead of making these
unpleasant little bargains.
Fine. You've got yourself a deal. Here's what you asked for, sweetheart. But don't
imagine I'm especially pleased about the way you've gone about getting it.
Very well. I'll give you what you want. You've been rather clever about this, I'll
admit. Though I do hope you understand that cleverness isn't always the same thing as
good manners.
Oh, darling, you didn't have to do all this. You know how much I love giving you
things. Here, take it. I just wish you hadn't felt the need to bargain with me.
Very well, sweetheart. You can have what you've asked for. But it makes me terribly
sad that you'd rather threaten your Other Mother than simply trust her to look after
you.
Fine. Take it. You've got what you wanted. But I strongly suggest you think very
carefully before trying something like this with me again.
There. Satisfied? You've made your little bargain, and I've kept my end of it. I
wouldn't mistake that for weakness if I were you.
Oh, darling, you really are becoming quite troublesome. Clever, certainly, but
troublesome. Here's your reward. I suppose you've earned it in your own peculiar way.
Very well, sweetheart. You win this little round. Take what you've asked for. Though
I do wonder how many more secrets you intend to collect before you finally decide
you've had enough.
Oh, sweetheart, no. I'm afraid we simply can't do that. I'm rather disappointed that
you've tried to turn this into some sort of bargain. That's not how families ought to
behave.
Darling, I don't think you quite understand what you're asking. I'm not going to give
you something just because you've found a few things you weren't supposed to. Let's
forget this unpleasantness.
No, sweetheart. Absolutely not. You've already caused quite enough trouble collecting
all this information. I'm certainly not going to reward you for it.
Oh, I don't think so. You've been testing my patience lately, and this is a
particularly poor way of trying to get what you want. I'm afraid the answer is no.
Oh, darling, please don't do this. I love you very much, but I won't let you use that
against me. Put these dreadful ideas aside, and we can forget the whole thing.
Sweetheart, I'm hurt. Truly. After everything I've done to make you happy, you've
decided to threaten me? No, my love. I'm afraid I cannot give you what you're asking
for.
No. And I suggest you stop speaking before you make things considerably worse for
yourself. You have absolutely no idea how much patience I've already shown you.
How dare you. You come into my world, steal my secrets, and think you can make
demands of me? No. You will get nothing, and we are going to have a very serious
conversation about your behavior.
Oh, darling. I was wondering when you'd finally push your luck too far. You've
learned so much about me, haven't you? But knowing my secrets doesn't mean you get to
make my decisions.
No, sweetheart. Not this time. You may know things I wish you didn't, but don't
confuse that with having power over me. I think you've forgotten whose world you're
standing in.
While you’re here, darling, you’re free to go home whenever you like. You can crawl
back through your little door, or simply go to bed and we’ll send you home ourselves.
But I do have plenty planned for you, so try not to wander off on your own.
Especially not too far from the house. There’s really nothing out there you need to
be looking for.
Of course, you don’t have to stay any longer than you want. The little door will take
you straight home, and if you get tired, you can always sleep here instead. But while
you are staying with us, I’d much rather you enjoy what we’ve prepared than go
wandering around by yourself. Some places are better left alone.
Now remember, sweetheart, you can leave whenever you’ve had enough. Crawl back
through your little door, or climb into bed and we’ll tuck you in before sending you
home. Until then, stay close and enjoy yourself. I’ve gone through an awful lot of
trouble for you, and I wouldn’t want you spoiling the fun by poking around where you
shouldn’t.
You’re never trapped here, darling. If you want to go home, your little door is right
where you left it, and sleeping here will take you home too. But while you’re
visiting, behave yourself and don’t run off exploring. Your Other Father and I have
made more than enough for you to enjoy right here.
Oh, sweetheart, I noticed you've been getting yourself into all sorts of dangerous
situations back home. So I thought I'd give you something to keep those nasty
creatures away.
Your Other Father and I have been putting together a few little things for you.
They're rather sharp, so do be careful. I'd hate for you to hurt those lovely
fingers.
You know, darling, it worries me terribly when I think of you out there fighting
those awful monsters. Here, I've made sure you'll have something much better to
defend yourself with.
There now. Doesn't that feel better? Nothing should be able to give you much trouble
with something like that in your hands.
Oh, look at you! Quite the little warrior, aren't you? Just promise me you'll be
careful. I'd be awfully upset if anything happened to you.
Much better than those dreadful old weapons you've been using, wouldn't you say? I do
wish you'd let me take care of these things more often.
Come here, sweetheart. I've been thinking about how terribly exposed you are out
there, running around without anything proper to protect you. I made you something.
I've noticed you've been coming home with an awful lot of bumps and bruises lately.
Well, I simply couldn't stand the thought of that continuing.
Your Other Father thinks I've been fussing over you too much, but I don't care. A
mother ought to make sure her little one is properly protected, don't you think?
Oh, that suits you beautifully! And it's ever so much stronger than it looks. I
wouldn't dream of letting you wear anything less.
There we are. All safe and sound. Now, I know it won't stop you getting into trouble,
but at least I won't have to worry quite so much.
Just look at how perfectly it fits. I made every little piece especially for you,
darling. Nobody else could have made something quite like it.
Oh, darling, you do spend an awful lot of time digging and chopping and working
yourself half to death. I thought perhaps I could make things a little easier.
I've been watching how hard you work on all those little projects of yours. It's
terribly impressive, of course, but you really shouldn't have to struggle so much.
Your Other Father made a few things for you in his workshop. Well, I helped him with
the important parts. I think you'll find them rather useful.
There! Now you can get twice as much done without all that dreadful effort. Isn't it
wonderful when someone thinks ahead for you?
Oh, I knew you'd like those. They're so much nicer than the worn-out things you've
been carrying around.
Just think of all the things you can make now, sweetheart. And whenever you need
something better, you know exactly where to come.
I've been thinking about that little house of yours. It's coming along nicely, but I
thought it could use a few more beautiful things.
Oh, sweetheart, you shouldn't have to spend all day digging up stones and chopping
down trees just to make yourself a lovely home. I've gathered a few things for you.
Your Other Father and I were talking about all those wonderful buildings you could
make. So naturally, I went ahead and collected some materials for you.
There you are! Plenty to work with now. I can't wait to see what you build, darling.
Perhaps something as pretty as our house.
Oh, imagine what you could make with all of that! A beautiful little cottage,
perhaps? Though I suppose you've already got a perfectly lovely home here.
Take every last piece, sweetheart. There are plenty more where those came from. You
really needn't spend so much time gathering things yourself.
I've noticed you like making those clever little contraptions of yours. All those
wires and switches and moving parts. I thought I'd bring you a few things to
experiment with.
Your Other Father has been tinkering away in his workshop again. He made the most
marvelous little machines, and I thought you might enjoy having some of the pieces.
Oh, darling, why do everything by hand when you can have a machine do it for you?
I've found some wonderful things that might save you an awful lot of trouble.
There! Now you can make all sorts of clever little inventions. Just be sure they
don't make too much noise, sweetheart.
I can already imagine the wonderful contraptions you'll build with those. Your Other
Father will be so pleased to hear what you've come up with.
Isn't it lovely when things take care of themselves? No more running about pressing
buttons and pulling levers all day. Though I must say, I've always been rather fond
of buttons.
Oh, sweetheart, I've been meaning to say something about those clothes of yours.
They're looking a little tired, don't you think? I've picked out something much
nicer.
I was going through my sewing things earlier, and I simply couldn't resist making you
a few new outfits. I think you'll look absolutely darling in them.
You know, I've always thought you deserved something a little more special to wear.
Something made just for you, rather than those ordinary things everyone else has.
Oh, just look at you! Absolutely precious. I knew those colors would suit you. A
mother always knows these things.
There we are! Doesn't that feel lovely? I made sure every stitch was perfect. I
wouldn't want my darling walking around in anything uncomfortable.
Oh, you look wonderful, sweetheart. You really ought to wear those more often. I'd
love to see you looking so lovely every time you visit.
Oh, darling, I've noticed how quiet things can get in that little world of yours. I
thought perhaps you could use something beautiful to listen to.
Your Other Father has been playing the most wonderful music lately, and it gave me an
idea. Why shouldn't you have a little music of your own?
I found some lovely old melodies tucked away, and I thought of you immediately.
There's something about a familiar song that makes a place feel like home, don't you
think?
There you are. Now you'll have something lovely to listen to whenever things get a
little lonely. Just close your eyes and imagine you're back here with us.
Oh, I do hope you enjoy those. Your Other Father can be rather particular about
music, but I think these are some of his very best.
Isn't that a pretty little tune? I thought you might like something to remind you of
us when you're away. It's always nice to have a little reminder of home.
Oh, sweetheart, I've got a surprise for you today! No peeking now. I went through an
awful lot of trouble to find something you'd never expect.
I've been keeping a little secret from you, darling. Nothing dreadful, of course!
Just something special I've been saving for the right moment.
Now, I've got something rather interesting for you. I won't tell you what it is just
yet. Where would the fun be in that?
Surprise! Oh, I do love that look on your face. I knew you wouldn't be expecting
something quite like that.
Well? What do you think, sweetheart? I had such a difficult time choosing, but
something told me that one was meant for you.
Oh, isn't that exciting? You never quite know what you'll find when you visit me, do
you? I suppose you'll just have to keep coming back to see what else I've got hidden
away.
There you are! Come in, come in. We’ve been working all day to make everything
perfect for you.
Oh, I’m so happy you came back. You haven’t even seen half of the wonderful things we
have planned yet.
Welcome, darling! Don’t just stand there. Come see what your Other Father and I made
for you this time.
You’re back. Good. I was beginning to think I’d have to send someone looking for you.
There you are, sweetheart. I’ve already got everything ready, so I hope you didn’t
come here just to wander around again.
I wondered when you’d arrive. You’ve become quite comfortable here lately… and quite
curious, too.
Welcome home, darling. I left everything just the way you like it.
There’s my favorite little troublemaker. I knew you wouldn’t stay away from home for
very long.
You don’t need to knock anymore, sweetheart. This is your home too, whether you’ve
realized it yet or not.
Well… you came back. I wasn’t sure you would after your behavior last time.
Welcome, sweetheart. I do hope today you’ll spend more time enjoying yourself and
less time poking around where you shouldn’t.
There you are. Let’s have a pleasant visit this time, shall we? I’d hate for there to
be any more… misunderstandings.
There you are, darling. You keep coming back, even after everything you’ve seen.
Isn’t that interesting?
Welcome home. You know so many of my little secrets now, and yet you still can’t seem
to stay away.
I was expecting you. You’ve been terribly curious lately… but I suppose that doesn’t
matter if you’ve finally decided where you belong.
Ah, there you are! Welcome to our little village. I’ve brought you twenty tokens, and
each one lets you collect a gift from any villager you choose. Some of them have
wonderful things, some... well, not quite so wonderful. You won’t know until you
spend one, though, so choose carefully.
Ah, perfect timing. One of these rooms contains the jackpot, and I’ve got exactly one
key for you. The mansion is full of clues, but none of them will simply hand you the
answer—you’ll have to compare what you find and work it out for yourself. Pick the
wrong door and, well... I hope you enjoy empty rooms.
Ah, welcome! The treasure is waiting at the very bottom of the temple, but getting
there takes a good memory. Each chamber will show you the one safe path across its
pressure plates, and then the markings disappear. Follow what you remember, because
one wrong step means you’re finished. Survive all five chambers and you can take
everything in the final vault.
Ah, our guest of honor has arrived! Here’s how tonight’s show works: watch the stage
very carefully, because once those curtains close, I’m going to change something. It
could be an object, a color, a creature—anything at all. When the curtains open, find
the difference and I’ll give you a token. There are twenty scenes in the show, and
every token you earn can be traded for prizes afterward.
Ah, ready for a climb? You’ve only got a few minutes, and this course goes much
higher than it looks. Keep moving upward—the farther you make it, the better the
prize waiting for you at the end. Fall if you must, just get back up and keep
climbing.
Ah, you made it! Here’s how our little feast works: every few moments, fresh dishes
will appear all across the table. The villagers will be after them too, so if you see
something you like, you’d better get to it before they do. Whatever you grab goes
straight into your feast basket, and by the later courses, the really good food
starts coming out.
Ah, perfect timing! The mice have been practicing all day for this. You’ll see races,
acrobatics, cannon jumps, and more before they all face off in the final event. Keep
an eye on whichever mouse catches your attention—you might be surprised who comes out
on top.
Ah, welcome! We’ve got games all over the carnival tonight, and I’ve brought you a
handful of tokens to enjoy them with. Spend a token whenever you want to play, and if
you do well, you’ll walk away with a prize. Pick whichever games catch your eye—just
remember, once those tokens are gone, your night at the midway is over.
Ah, there you are! Welcome to the garden. It’s lovely from down here, of course, but
you haven’t really seen it until you’ve seen the whole thing from above.
Welcome! Tonight you’re not just here to listen—you get a stage of your own. When
you’re ready, start the performance and follow the keys as they appear. Every good
streak draws a bigger crowd, and the bigger the crowd, the more they’ll throw into
your prize pool. Wrong notes send people walking, so keep them entertained for all
three minutes and whatever they leave behind is yours.
Ah, welcome! Here—one thousand shopping tokens, all yours. The mall is full of
different stores, and each one has something a little different waiting inside. You
can wander wherever you like and buy whatever catches your eye, but once those tokens
are gone, that’s the end of your shopping trip. So try not to spend the whole lot in
the first shop you see.
Ready for a fight? Grab your snowballs and keep moving. Every hit knocks down a
little health, and once someone’s health reaches zero, they’re eliminated. Yours
works exactly the same way, so don’t spend too much time standing still. Take out
everyone else, survive to the end, and the winner gets the prize.
Ah, ready to bake? You and four other contestants have exactly two minutes to put
together your best cake. Choose your flavors, toppings, and decorations carefully,
because once the timer ends, the judges will compare all five cakes. Make theirs look
ordinary next to yours, and the prize is all yours.
Ah, ready to fish? You and the other contestants have three minutes to catch whatever
the water decides to give you. Some catches won’t be worth much, and others could be
surprisingly valuable, so keep that line moving. At the end, we’ll add up the value
of everything you caught, and whoever has the richest haul wins.
Ah, ready to test your aim? There are targets all across the range, but I’ve only
given you so many arrows to work with. Take your time, line up your shots, and bring
every target down. Clear the whole course before your quiver is empty, and you’ll win
the prize.
Ah, ready to race? Grab a boat and take your place at the starting line. You’ll have
plenty of competition out there, and this ice can send you spinning if you’re
careless. Beat everyone else to the finish and you’ll take home the grand prize.
Ah, ready to get lost? This garden is quite a bit bigger on the inside than it looks.
You’ve got until the timer runs out to find your way through and reach the finish.
Take too many wrong turns and you may run out of time, but make it to the end and the
prize is yours.
Ah, ready for a hunt? Somewhere out there is a rather valuable treasure, but you
won’t find it without following the clues. Each one will lead you to another, and
some of them may take a bit of thinking. Watch out for fake chests and misleading
spots along the way. Find the final treasure before time runs out, and it’s yours.
Ah, ready to do some mining? The tunnels are full of ore, and for the next few
minutes you can take as much of it as you’re able to reach. Coal and iron are easy
enough to find, but the really valuable veins are hidden deeper in. Whatever you mine
before the timer ends goes home with you.
Ah, ready for a swim? The Guardians along this track are going to try their very best
to keep those lasers on you. Don’t let them finish charging—duck behind prismarine,
change direction, and keep pushing forward. Make it through the entire monument
without getting fully blasted, and you’ll earn the reward at the finish.
Ah, ready for a drop? There’s a pool of lava waiting far below you, but getting there
is the tricky part. Dodge the fortress bridges, chains, blocks, and whatever else
gets in your way as you fall. Reach the lava without crashing into anything, and
you’ll earn the reward.
Ah, this one’s a little strange. You’re sealed inside the room, and the only way out
is through Chorus Fruit. Every bite will teleport you somewhere nearby, so keep
eating and use a little luck—and maybe a little patience—until one of those jumps
puts you outside. Make it out and you win.
